digest.component_or_area: Code review criteria language (tests and error-handling dimensions)
propositions: Code review currently lacks detection language for fail-open checks whose PASS or FAIL result is indistinguishable from the check never running (producer liveness defect)
The nine calibration instances split into two populations: five are test-code oracles (tests criterion host), four are shipped code checks (error-handling criterion host)
The fail-open pattern has a mirror: a check can also produce a confident FAILING result for a reason other than the condition, and the criterion must cover both absent-pass and false-alarm-fail cases

Fail-open detection language must be added to existing tests and error-handling criteria (not a new criterion) with a common litmus: name every world in which the check produces any definite result; if 'producer never ran / emitted nothing' is among them, the check cannot distinguish its verdict from its own failure

The implementation spans six files (two reviewer rubrics, one routing registry, two eval specs, one user guide) and requires calibration replay of 18 cases (9 pre-fix must fire with grounded finding, 9 post-fix must be silent) with FP posture already blocking in both hosts
Documentation must reach the code-review author surface (rebar explain review) with two worked examples from the corpus since per-criterion explain is not available for code-review criteria
